findingDetails.title: The CLI build path's authored-root guard is not covered
findingDetails.case: A future edit drops the requireAuthoredRoot() call on the no-args build path (compiled-route-sync.cjs:1110) and the suite stays green: T2 spawns the CLI with --check only, and the existing build tests call sync.build() directly with injected roots.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Searched the reviewed test file for a no-args CLI spawn in a pruned tree; none found. The only CLI spawn against a missing authored tree uses --check.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: Guard is one shared function with two call sites, so one CLI test may be judged representative; the spec asks one test per behavior change, not per call site.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: An existing or added test that spawns the CLI with no mode against a missing specs/ tree and asserts the one-line failure.
findingDetails.recommendation: Extend T2 to also spawn with no mode in its sandbox; the guard throws before any build write, so the assertion is the same single SYNC FAILED: line.

findingDetails.title: Authored twin is derived from the runtime layout, so diverging generations yield a wrong authored-missing path
findingDetails.case: A runtime root coherent under the legacy layout while the authored program has moved to the current layout (e.g. a --revert installs an older-generation runtime after the authored closure moved) makes authoredDrift derive a retired legacy path under the authored root and report authored-missing with a restore instruction for that retired path.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Live tree: runtime root carries the current layout and the authored 013-live-activation/activation tree carries all seven hubs, so steady state is unaffected. The pre-commit route-remint gate shares the same mirror-relative derivation (pre-commit:642).
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: Mirror-relative derivation may be the project single model for the pair, making generation divergence an unsupported state rather than a bug.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: A migration runbook or test showing runtime and authored layouts always advance together before the guard can observe them.
findingDetails.recommendation: When the authored root exists and resolves a coherent layout, resolve the twin through the authored tree (or fall back to manifestPathIn(authoredRoot, hubId)) before concluding authored-missing; keep the derived path only to name the missing file when the authored tree is gone.
